body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm a data scientist with 4+ years shipping production ML systems and experimentation infrastructure -- and I'm applying for the Senior Data Scientist role at Webflow. What caught my attention: Webflow's 2025 launch of an MCP server enabling AI agents to interact with site data in real-time signals a company actively rethinking how data and AI intersect with product. That's exactly the space I want to be building in.

Experimentation and product analytics aren't resume bullets for me -- they're how I've worked. At Community Dreams Foundation, I defined the full metrics framework for an AI Voice Assistant (answer accuracy, deflection rate, task completion, latency), ran iterative A/B tests, and drove a 22% accuracy improvement over three model cycles. I wrote DBT transformations to keep our Snowflake-backed pipelines clean and reproducible. At Kameleon, I built segmentation and churn models that directly informed retention campaigns lifting 90-day retention by 12-15%, and delivered Tableau dashboards that gave executives a real-time view of product health.

The thing I'd point to as most directly relevant here: I know how to work with product teams in ambiguous environments, define the right metrics before touching a model, and turn analysis into decisions -- not just reports. My portfolio at rohitananthan.info shows how I think through problems end to end.

Would love to connect and talk through how I'd contribute to Webflow's data science roadmap.

Rohit Ananthan
rohitananthan123@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/rohit-ananthan | rohitananthan.info
